Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: After confirming from Wikipedia that the performer (Mauro Scocco) was born on 11 September 1962, the Planner incorrectly “standardized” the date to MM/DD as 11/09/1962 and interpreted it as November 9, 1962. The correct MM/DD conversion should be 09/11/1962 (September 11, 1962). This month/day swap introduced the wrong birth date.
